title: How to use AI to learn any skill 10x faster

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "how" of AI learning is about protocols—specific, repeatable steps that scale across any skill. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But without a "to," you're just following steps without purpose. Real mastery comes from targeted goals. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI adapts to your goals through reinforcement learning—tailoring paths in real time with LLM feedback loops. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without a clear "to," AI becomes a generic tool. Mastery needs direction—like a curriculum, not just a protocol. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Skill without purpose is just noise. The "to" gives AI a target. (4 sec)
